name: Advanced Cooling System Protection

features.text: Compatible with all reservoir style cooling systems that use Ethylene Glycol based coolant
Fortifies and extends service life of new coolant
Lowers metal loss to less then 1 mg
Can help regulate EV Battery Temperatures
Can be used in HEV, EV and ICE cooling systems.

description: Designed to fortify coolants used in hybrid-electrical vehicles (HEV) and battery electrical vehicles (BEV) with advanced corrosion inhibitors. It is formulated for use in all types of ethylene glycol based, low-conductivity coolants used in indirect cooling systems.
application: SHAKE WELL! If used between services, allow cooling system to cool before removing radiator or reservoir cap to add product. 1) Remove radiator or reservoir cap and add entire contents of container to cooling system. 2) Replace radiator or reservoir cap & allow vehicle to idle for 10-15 minutes.
review: Spelling corrected from the old sheet: coolings systems -> cooling systems

ad.headline: Maximize Performance
ad.description:
Designed to fortify coolants used in hybrid-electrical vehicles (HEV) and battery electrical vehicles (BEV) with advanced corrosion inhibitors. It is formulated for use in all types of ethylene glycol based, low-conductivity coolants used in indirect cooling systems.

Standard factory-fill coolant, on average, can allow up to 5 mg of metal loss and still meet OEM requirements . When adding MP Protect™ after a service, metal loss can be lowered to less than 1 mg, fortifying and extending the service life of new coolant.
benefits: Compatible with all types of coolant when used in indirect cooling systems.
Fortifies and extends service life of new coolant.
Lowers metal loss to less than 1 mg.
Can help regulate EV Battery Temperatures.
